children: Milan, October 07, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has today upgraded the ratings of four notes in Madrid RMBS I, FTA and Madrid RMBS II, FTA. The notes are backed by residential mortgage loan contracts originated by Caja de Ahorros y Monte de Piedad de Madrid, respectively, and serviced by CaixaBank, S.A. We affirmed the ratings of six notes that had sufficient credit enhancement to maintain their current ratings.

title: Moody's Ratings upgrades ratings in Madrid RMBS I, FTA and Madrid RMBS II, FTA, two Spanish prime RMBS transactions
